notablePrerequisites: Diamond Lion has at least one Equipment attached.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Diamond Lion, adding {C}{C}.
Diamond Lion dies, triggering Koll, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
Diamond Lion enters the battlefield, triggering Kemba, attaching any Equipment you control to it.
Repeat.
